plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Psychology-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (source file titled 'Psychology Degree Map 2022'; printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023 (the academic year beginning Autumn 2022, the map's Year 1 Autumn term): this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The degree name is printed on the map as 'Psychology, B.A.'. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total; under its printed rule ('All classes are 5 credits unless followed by a parenthesis with a number, indicating the number of credits') every slot is 5 credits (the only parentheticals printed in the table are minimum grades, '(min 2.0)' and '(min 2.5 grade)', not credit numbers), so each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Four fixed courses are printed with a code and no course title (BIS 170, BIS 300, BIS 312, BIS 499); their titles are recorded as 'no title printed on the degree map' rather than supplied from any other source. Printed minimum grades are disclosed here, not encoded: BIS 215 'or equivalent (min 2.0)', BIS 300 '(min 2.0 grade)', BIS 312 '(min 2.0 grade)', BIS 499 '(min 2.5 grade)'. BIS 215 is recorded as the named fixed course; its printed 'or equivalent' alternative names no other course. Markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major' (printed on BIS 170, B WRIT 134, BIS 215 and B WRIT 135), the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major' (printed on BIS 300, BIS 312, the BISPY Core Course and BIS 499), the open diamond means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core', and the star means 'See list of choices'. The star-marked choice lists are not printed on the map itself, so the star-marked slots (200-level Psychology, 300/400-level Psychology, the IPR Course) list no options. Generic slots (NSc, A&H, Elective, IAS Coursework) are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots. No course prerequisites are recorded because the map prints none.
